The '''Lord of Agony''' was a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] that allied himself to the [[Dread Masters]] during the [[Great Galactic War]]. The lord of Agony was tasked with the mission to recover the ''[[Fatality]]'', a starship full of prototype [[HK-51]] droids, crashed on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] on a frozen lake near the [[Section X]] of [[The Tomb]].
However the Lord was stopped and defeated by a spacer.
